lines.text: The root is Flect! Deflect, reflection.
Did you know? Flect is Latin for bend.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus bend?

words.ex: The ball must be deflected before its path will change.
We saw our reflection in the water.

publish.title: Flect root: deflect and reflection
publish.value: Flect comes from Latin "flectere" (to bend). Words: deflect and reflection. deflect = de + flect; reflection = re + flect.
